risks.risk: Engine may be incomplete or missing critical components (covers, sensors, hoses, fasteners), making it unusable or requiring extra parts.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory shot showing every included part, plus a photo of the engine assembly from multiple angles with all connectors/sensors present and labeled.

risks.risk: Unknown mechanical health (compression, internal damage) despite claims of 'no knock'—photos cannot confirm internal condition.
risks.proof: A short video of the engine running from cold start (or a compression test sheet with readings) showing stable idle and no abnormal noises.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven mechanically (worst case: may need overhaul).

risks.risk: Surface rust/grime may indicate poor storage or possible corrosion; could affect mounting points, seals, or electrical connectors.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all gasket/seal areas, connector pins, and any rusted mounting surfaces, plus a wipe/clean test showing whether rust is superficial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential corrosion risk and possible seal replacement.

risks.risk: Leaks (oil/fuel/coolant) and gasket integrity cannot be confirmed from the current images.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine after cleaning with visible wet/dry status, and a leak-check video (especially around head gasket, oil pan area, and hoses).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential leak risk (worst case: gaskets/seals may need replacement).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: exact make/model is not readable; ECU/immobilizer/key wiring may be missing or mismatched.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate/stamp and any ECU/part numbers, plus a photo showing the full wiring harness and connectors included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown compatibility (worst case: may not fit without additional parts).

proof_requests: Clear photos of the engine identification plate/stamp and any readable make/model/part numbers.
A complete parts list with photos of everything included (sensors, ECU, wiring harness, hoses, fasteners, covers) laid out and counted.
Video of the engine running (cold start if possible) showing no abnormal knocking and stable idle.
Compression test results (readings) or a mechanic’s test report with dates.
Photos of gasket/seal areas and connector pins after cleaning, plus a leak-check video.
response.reason: The witness confirms a motorcycle engine/upper assembly that appears partially disassembled, but the key claims (tested/working, no knock, low mileage, never opened) are not verifiable from the photos.
